correctness.rationale: For all positive m,n, regular Boolean cell complex of injective words modulo commutation of adjacent same-color letters. Acyclic complete bipartite orientation ≡ linearly nested left-row neighbor sets (directed cycle iff directed four-cycle), so g=(σ,τ)-fixed orientations are uniformly determined on selected σ- and τ-cycles and equal acyclic orientations of smaller K_{a,b}. A selected permutation cycle of length ell contributes (-1)^ell in alternating augmented count times (-1)^(ell−1) in cellular orientation sign, hence -1. Augmented Lefschetz and known top-sphere homology yield χ(g)=sgnσ sgnτ β(K_{cσ,cτ}), with known Stirling β formula. Group-invariant cellular chains only admit strictly alternating color blocks: any same-color block of size≥2 has orientation-reversing stabilizer. Their alternating Euler dimensions give 1 for m=n and 0 otherwise. Independent exact β formula and 25 full symmetric-group averaging computations (1≤m,n≤5) agree, including β(K3,3)=73 and β(K3,4)=301; finite checks are not proof of all m,n. The general cycle contraction and Euler argument supply unbounded proof.
